summary: Verified sanitiseSlug implementation in mcp-server/gui/public/views/strategy.js against all 5 acceptance criteria.

comments.note: strategy.js sanitiseSlug: trailing hyphens are not stripped (e.g. 'my-folder ' → 'my-folder-'). This is a minor cosmetic issue — the output is still SLUG_REGEX-valid and the WP spec does not require trailing-hyphen removal. Not a blocker; flagging for awareness.

No automated tests exist for strategy.js (vanilla browser JS). The pure nature of sanitiseSlug makes it straightforward to unit-test in isolation if a test harness is ever added. Consider extracting slug utilities to a shared module testable via vitest in a future WP.
